title: Projectile Motion
concept: How launch conditions affect a projectile
learningObjective: Predict how velocity and angle change a projectile's path.
sourceSummary: Projectile range, height, and flight time depend on launch velocity, launch angle, and gravity.

sourceEvidence.text: The horizontal range of a projectile depends on its launch speed, angle, and gravitational acceleration.

variables.label: Launch velocity
variables.description: The velocity at which the object is launched.

variables.label: Launch angle
variables.description: The angle of launch above the ground.

variables.label: Gravity
variables.description: The downward acceleration caused by gravity.

challenge.prompt: Adjust the launch so the object lands between 35 and 45 meters.
challenge.hint: Try changing the angle before increasing the velocity.
challenge.successMessage: You found a launch configuration that reaches the target.

explanationTemplate: At {velocity} m/s and {angle} degrees, the projectile travels {range} meters.
